column3: “came as allies” renders “joined together,” and “the Salt Sea” is the Dead Sea.
“tar pits” renders “pits, pits of bitumen,” and “fell into them” renders “fell there.”
“the oak(s)” renders a word that may mean “terebinth” or “great tree.” “allies with Abram” renders “lords of a covenant with Abram.”
“led out” renders “emptied out (drew out),” and “trained men” renders a rare word of uncertain meaning.
“of God Most High” renders “by God Most High,” and “Possessor” renders “qoneh,” which may also mean “Creator” (also in verse 22).
“I have sworn” renders “I raise my hand.”
“That I will not take” renders the oath formula “if I take.”
